# Invoiceo: full description

> Invoiceo is free, open-source (MIT) offline billing and GST invoice software for Windows, macOS and Linux, made by Madcreations (India). This file collects the main text of https://invoiceo.in/ in one place, for AI assistants and other readers.

- Current version: 1.0.8, released 28 October 2026 (2026-10-28)
- Made by: Madcreations, India
- Website: https://invoiceo.in/ (also in Tamil: https://invoiceo.in/ta.html, and Hindi: https://invoiceo.in/hi.html)
- Price: free, with no subscription, trial or paid tier; custom features are a paid service, quoted per request
- Licence: MIT License. Built on Invoiso by ANOOP P (MIT License, © 2025 ANOOP P)

## What Invoiceo is

Free billing software that works offline. Create GST invoices, quotations and receipts on your own computer. Invoiceo is a free, open-source desktop app — no invoice limit, no subscription, no sign-up, and your business data never leaves your PC.

## Why Invoiceo

- **Free forever**: No subscription, no trial, no paid tier. Every feature is included, for as long as you use it.
- **Works offline**: Bill, print and run reports with no internet connection. Internet down? Keep billing.
- **Your data stays with you**: Customers, products and invoices are saved on your computer, not on someone else’s server.
- **Open source**: The source code is public under the MIT License. Anyone can check what the app does.
- **Windows, macOS and Linux**: One app for the computers you already have, with the same features on each.
- **No lock-in**: Back up any time, restore on another computer, and export your lists to CSV or PDF.

## How it works

1. **Set up your business**: Add your company name, logo, GSTIN, bank details and UPI ID once.
2. **Add customers and products**: Import a list from CSV, or add them as you bill. Barcode scanners work too.
3. **Create an invoice**: Pick the customer and search or scan items. Tax and totals are worked out for you.
4. **Print, save or share**: Print on A4 or a thermal printer, or save a PDF to send to your customer.
5. **Track payments**: Record full or part payments, print receipts and see who still owes you.

## Features

### Invoicing

- Six invoice designs plus a thermal receipt layout
- Print or save PDF on A4, A5, A6 or 58/80 mm
- Automatic invoice numbering with your prefix
- Discounts, taxes and extra charges
- Your own custom fields on invoices
- Save unfinished invoices as drafts

### Running the business

- Quotations that become invoices in one click
- Full and part payments, with receipts
- Customers with outstanding balances
- Products and services, stock, batch and expiry
- Sales, tax, receivables, daily and stock reports
- Import and export lists as CSV

### India & GST

- Your GSTIN and your customer’s on every invoice
- HSN/SAC codes per product
- CGST + SGST or IGST worked out for you
- Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply titles
- Your UPI QR code printed on the bill

### Local-first and private

- Works with no internet connection
- Data saved on your own computer
- Backup and restore in one click
- Several companies on one computer
- Staff logins with admin or user roles
- No online account needed

### Ready for anywhere

- Choose your currency
- English, Tamil, Hindi, Nepali, French, Spanish, Chinese and Tibetan (partly translated)
- Tamil text prints correctly on PDFs and receipts
- USB barcode scanners
- Thermal receipts can print automatically after each sale

## Who it is for

- **Kirana and retail shops**: Fast counter billing with barcode scanning and thermal receipts.
- **Pharmacies and medical shops**: Batch numbers and expiry dates on products, with low-stock warnings.
- **Traders and wholesalers**: GST invoices with HSN codes, stock levels and customer balances.
- **Freelancers and consultants**: Clean PDF quotations and invoices, and a clear view of who has paid.
- **Service and repair shops**: Quick bills for parts and labour, part payments and receipts.
- **Any small business**: Several companies and staff logins on one computer — all free.

## Made for India, works anywhere

- GSTIN, HSN/SAC and CGST + SGST or IGST
- UPI QR code on your invoices
- Amounts in rupees by default
- Tamil and Hindi on screen and on paper
- Pick the currency you bill in
- Eight app languages (Tibetan partly translated)
- A4, A5, A6 and 58/80 mm paper
- GST fields stay out of the way when you don’t need them

App languages: English, Tamil, Hindi, Nepali, French, Spanish, Chinese and Tibetan (partly translated).

## Screens

- **Dashboard**: Money collected and still due, sales by month, invoice status and recent invoices.
- **New invoice**: Customer, items, GST and the total on one screen.
- **Invoices**: See what’s paid, unpaid or part paid, and find any bill fast.
- **Customers**: Phone, GSTIN and what each customer still owes.
- **Products**: Prices, HSN codes, tax and stock levels, with low stock easy to spot.
- **Reports**: Billed, collected and outstanding money month by month.

## Download and install

Download page: https://invoiceo.in/download.html. Every installer is free, with no sign-up, no licence key and no subscription. SHA-256 checksums are linked on the download page.

### Windows

- Requirements: Windows 10 and 11 · 64-bit
- Files: Invoiceo-Setup-Windows.exe (https://invoiceo.in/download.html#windows)
- Steps:
  1. Open the downloaded file.
  2. If Windows shows **“Windows protected your PC”**, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**. This appears because the installer is not code-signed yet.
  3. Follow the setup. Invoiceo then opens from the Start menu.

### macOS

- Requirements: macOS 12 Monterey or later
- Files: Invoiceo-macOS.dmg (https://invoiceo.in/download.html#macos)
- Steps:
  1. Open the .dmg and drag Invoiceo into Applications.
  2. Open Invoiceo. If macOS says it cannot verify the app, click **Done**. This happens because the app is not notarised by Apple yet.
  3. Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to the message about Invoiceo and click **Open Anyway**, then confirm. (On macOS 14 or older you can instead Control-click Invoiceo in Applications and choose **Open**.)
  4. After that it opens normally.

### Linux

- Requirements: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Mint 21+ and others
- Files: Invoiceo-Linux.deb, Invoiceo-Linux.AppImage (https://invoiceo.in/download.html#linux)
- Steps:
  1. **.deb** (Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Linux Mint 21+): run `sudo apt install ./Invoiceo-Linux.deb` in the folder you downloaded it to.
  2. **AppImage** (other distributions): run `chmod +x Invoiceo-Linux.AppImage`, then open the file.

### First steps

1. **Download**: Pick your computer on the download page (https://invoiceo.in/download.html).
2. **Install**: Open the file and follow the steps.
3. **Sign in and set up**: The first screen shows how to sign in. Then add your business details.
4. **First invoice**: Add a customer and items, then create the invoice.
5. **Print or PDF**: Print on A4 or a thermal printer, or save a PDF.

### Updating to a new version

Download the new installer and install it over the old version. Your data is kept, but make a backup first from **Settings → Backup** in the app. The [release notes for every version](https://invoiceo.in/changelog.html) show what changed.

## How Invoiceo compares (https://invoiceo.in/compare.html)

Checked on 31 October 2026 from each company’s own website. "Not listed" means their page did not say. Plans and limits change.

**The free plan**

- Invoiceo: Free forever. Every feature included, no limit on invoices, customers or computers
- Vyapar: Basic features free on mobile; desktop is a free trial
- myBillBook: Free sign-up; plan prices are on a separate page
- Tally: 7-day free trial, then paid plans
- Sleek Bill: Free basic version, limited to 10 documents a month

**Works without internet**

- Invoiceo: Yes, fully
- Vyapar: Offline billing, then syncs to the cloud
- myBillBook: Apps with real-time cloud sync
- Tally: Yes
- Sleek Bill: Yes

**Sign-up or account**

- Invoiceo: None
- Vyapar: Phone number to download
- myBillBook: Sign-up
- Tally: Form for the free trial
- Sleek Bill: Direct download, no sign-up

**Where your data is kept**

- Invoiceo: Only on your computer
- Vyapar: Your device, with cloud backup and sync
- myBillBook: Cloud
- Tally: Your computer
- Sleek Bill: Your PC, with optional sync

**Open source**

- Invoiceo: Yes (MIT License)
- Vyapar: No
- myBillBook: No
- Tally: No
- Sleek Bill: No

**Phone app**

- Invoiceo: No, computers only
- Vyapar: Yes
- myBillBook: Yes
- Tally: Not listed
- Sleek Bill: Not listed

**GST returns, e-invoice, e-way bill**

- Invoiceo: Not built in. A Tax report by rate (CSV or PDF) for your accountant
- Vyapar: E-invoice, e-way bill and GST returns
- myBillBook: GSTR-1, 2, 3B, e-invoice and e-way bill
- Tally: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, e-way bill and e-invoicing
- Sleek Bill: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2A reports

**Send bills on WhatsApp or email**

- Invoiceo: Not built in. Save the PDF and attach it
- Vyapar: WhatsApp sharing and reminders
- myBillBook: WhatsApp and SMS reminders
- Tally: Not listed
- Sleek Bill: Optional email of invoices

**Accounting**

- Invoiceo: Sales, tax, profit, receivables and stock reports. No ledgers or balance sheet
- Vyapar: Accounting as an add-on
- myBillBook: Bookkeeping and bank reconciliation
- Tally: Full accounting
- Sleek Bill: Ledgers, profit and loss, cash and bank book

**Languages**

- Invoiceo: 8 app languages; Tamil prints correctly on PDFs and receipts
- Vyapar: 9+ Indian languages
- myBillBook: Not listed
- Tally: Not listed
- Sleek Bill: Not listed

Choose Invoiceo if: You want billing that is free for good, with no invoice cap and no trial that ends; You want your data on your own computer, with no sign-up and no cloud account; You print on A4 or 58/80 mm thermal printers, or need Tamil or Hindi on your bills; You want open-source software, or a small custom feature made for your business at a fair price.

Choose another if: You file GST returns from the software, or need e-invoice and e-way bill; You need a phone app, or several shops or computers working on the same data; You want WhatsApp or SMS reminders sent from the software; You need full accounting with ledgers and a balance sheet.

Not built in to Invoiceo: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B files, e-invoice and e-way bill; Sending an invoice on WhatsApp or email from inside the app; A phone app (it runs on Windows, macOS and Linux computers); A supplier and purchase section (the app records sales); Live sharing of data between computers, or a cloud version; Ledgers, balance sheet and full accounting.

## Frequently asked questions

### About Invoiceo

**Is Invoiceo really free?**

Yes. The app and its updates are free, with no subscription and no trial period. You can install it on as many of your computers as you like. We only charge for work done for you on request, such as a new bill format or a report. See [Customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html).

**Is Invoiceo open source?**

Yes. Invoiceo is released under the MIT License, so anyone can read, use and change the code. It is based on Invoiso by ANOOP P, which is also MIT-licensed.

**How can it be free?**

There is no paid version. Development is supported by optional [paid customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html) for businesses that need something special, and by [donations](https://buymeacoffee.com/madcreations).

**Do I need an internet connection?**

No. Invoiceo runs on your computer, so you can bill, print and see reports offline. You need a connection only to download the installer, to open our website or forms, or to share a PDF online.

**Do I need to create an account?**

No online account or sign-up is needed. The app has its own login on your computer, so you can protect it with a password and give each person their own username.

**Where is my data stored?**

Everything you enter is saved on your own computer, in the app’s data folder. Your customers, products and invoices are not sent to us. Because the data is on your computer, keeping it safe is in your hands: use **Settings → Backup** in the app regularly.

**Does Invoiceo collect any data?**

Only a few anonymous usage counts, so we know how many people use the app: when it is first opened, once a day while it is used, and once when the first invoice is made. Each count carries a random ID, the app version and the operating system, nothing else. Your customers, products, invoices, amounts and company details are never sent. You can turn the counts off in **Settings → Software Info**. See the [privacy policy](https://invoiceo.in/privacy.html).

### Billing and printing

**Can I use Invoiceo for GST billing?**

Yes. You can add your GSTIN and your customers’ GSTINs, HSN/SAC codes and tax rates per product or for the whole invoice. Invoices show CGST and SGST, or IGST for sales to another state, and you can choose titles such as Tax Invoice or Bill of Supply. Invoiceo helps you prepare correct invoices; for filing returns, please follow your accountant’s advice.

**Can I use it outside India?**

Yes. Choose the currency you bill in and one of eight app languages. GST fields can be turned off in the invoice settings when you don’t need them.

**Which printers can I use?**

Any printer your computer can print to, for A4, A5 and A6 invoices. For receipts, Invoiceo supports 58 mm and 80 mm thermal printers and can print the receipt automatically after each sale (in the Modern layout).

**Can I use it in Tamil?**

Yes. The app can be used in English, Tamil, Hindi, Nepali, French, Spanish, Chinese and Tibetan (partly translated), and Tamil names print correctly on PDFs and thermal receipts.

**Does it work with a barcode scanner?**

Yes. A USB barcode scanner that types the code works on the New Invoice screen: scan a product to add it to the bill.

**Is it right for a small shop?**

Yes. Barcode scanning, thermal receipts, stock levels, batch and expiry dates, and daily sales reports are built in. See [all the features](https://invoiceo.in/#features).

**Can I manage more than one business?**

Yes. You can add several companies on one computer. Each company keeps its own customers, products, invoices and settings.

**Can more than one person use it?**

Yes, on the same computer. Each person can have their own login, as an admin or a normal user.

### Installing and updating

**Which computers does it run on?**

Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), macOS 12 Monterey or later, and Linux: a .deb for Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+ and Linux Mint 21+, and an AppImage for other distributions. There is no phone app.

**Windows says “Windows protected your PC”. Is it safe?**

This message appears for installers that are not code-signed yet. If you downloaded Invoiceo from this website, click **More info** and then **Run anyway**. The [Windows install steps](https://invoiceo.in/download.html#windows) walk you through it.

**macOS says it cannot check the app for malicious software.**

The app is not notarised by Apple yet. Click **Done**, open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down to the message about Invoiceo and click **Open Anyway**. On macOS 14 or older, Control-click Invoiceo in Applications and choose **Open**. You only need to do this the first time.

**How do I update to a new version?**

Download the new version from the [Download page](https://invoiceo.in/download.html) and install it over the old one. Your data is kept, but make a backup first to be safe. See what changed on the [What’s new page](https://invoiceo.in/changelog.html).

**How do I move to a new computer?**

Make a backup of each company on the old computer, copy the backup file to the new one, [install Invoiceo there](https://invoiceo.in/download.html) and import the backup from **Settings → Backup**.

### Limits and what is not built in

**Is there any limit on invoices?**

No. There is no limit on invoices, customers, products or computers, and no trial period. Every feature is included.

**Does Invoiceo file GST returns, or make e-invoices and e-way bills?**

Not built in. Invoiceo prints correct GST invoices and gives a **Tax report** by tax rate (taxable amount and tax) that you can save as CSV or PDF and give to your accountant. It does not make GSTR-1 or GSTR-3B files, e-invoices or e-way bills. If you need these, they can be built as [paid customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html). Tell us the format you need.

**Can I send an invoice on WhatsApp or email from the app?**

Not directly. Save the invoice as a PDF (or print it) and attach it in WhatsApp or email. A one-click send button can be built as [paid customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html).

**Can I record purchases and supplier bills?**

The free app records sales and keeps a purchase price and stock count for each product. A separate supplier and purchase section is not part of the free app; it can be built as [paid customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html).

**Can two computers use the same data?**

Not live. Each computer keeps its own data, and there is no sync between computers or a cloud version. The simplest setup is one main billing computer where everyone logs in with their own user. To move data to another computer, use **Settings → Backup**. Sharing data between computers can be looked at as [paid customization](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html).

**How is Invoiceo different from Vyapar, myBillBook or Tally?**

Invoiceo is free with no limits, works fully offline, needs no sign-up and is open source. The others have more features, such as GST returns, e-invoicing and phone apps, but their free plans are limited or are trials. See the [side-by-side comparison](https://invoiceo.in/compare.html).

### Help and custom work

**Can you add a feature for my business?**

Yes, as a paid service, quoted per request. Tell us what you need on the [Customization page](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html).

**How do I get help?**

Use the support form or write to us. All the ways to reach us are on the [Contact page](https://invoiceo.in/contact.html).

## Privacy

Invoiceo keeps your business data on your computer. Nothing about your customers, prices or sales is sent to us or anyone else.

Summary of the privacy policy (https://invoiceo.in/privacy.html):

### The Invoiceo app

- **Your business data stays on your computer.** The customers, products, invoices, payments, settings and backups you create are stored on the computer where Invoiceo is installed. We do not receive a copy. The FAQ explains [where your data is stored and how to back it up](https://invoiceo.in/faq.html#about-invoiceo).
- **Anonymous usage counts.** So that we know how many people use Invoiceo, the app (from [version 1.0.4](https://invoiceo.in/changelog.html#v1.0.4)) sends us a short message when it is first opened, once a day while it is used, and once when the first invoice is created. Each message carries only a random ID made for this purpose, the app version and the operating system (Windows, macOS or Linux). It never includes your customers, products, invoices, amounts or company details. The messages go to a small server we run on Cloudflare, which does not store IP addresses; Cloudflare’s handling is described in the [Cloudflare Privacy Policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/). You can turn this off in the app under **Settings → Software Info**.
- **Update check.** Once a day, when you are online, the app asks GitHub whether a newer version of Invoiceo exists; that is an ordinary web request, so GitHub sees your IP address. Apart from this and the usage counts, the app goes online only when you click a link that opens your web browser.
- **No online account.** The app’s usernames and passwords exist only on your computer.
- **No advertising** and no selling of data, ever.
- **Links you choose to open.** Some buttons in the app open a web page in your browser (for example this website, our forms or Buy Me a Coffee). What happens on those pages is covered below or by that site’s own policy.
- **Backups and PDFs.** Files you export or share are handled by you; we have no access to them.

### This website

- **Hosting.** This site is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub may record technical information such as your IP address when you visit, as described in the [GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement). Installers are downloaded from GitHub as well.
- **Fonts.** The text font (Manrope) is loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser fetches it from Google’s servers when a page opens. Google’s handling of this is described in the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- **Forms.** Our support, customization and feedback forms are Google Forms. What you type into them (such as your name, email, phone number and message) is sent to our Google account so that we can reply. Google’s handling of it is described in the [Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).
- **Analytics.** This website uses Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages and download buttons are used. It sets cookies in your browser for this. Google Analytics does not store IP addresses, and we have turned off its advertising features. We use it only to improve the site. You can block these cookies in your browser settings.
- **Email and WhatsApp.** If you contact us, we keep the conversation so that we can help you and follow up.

## Customization (paid, quoted per request)

Invoiceo is free to use. When a business needs something more, Madcreations can build it. Every request is quoted on its own, and the customer decides before any work starts. Prices depend on the work, so no fixed prices are listed. Request form: https://invoiceo.in/customization.html#request

Examples of what can be made:

- **Energy and power-sale bills**: Monthly bills for wind and solar power: units, rate, deductions and net amount. [See the one we built](https://invoiceo.in/customization.html#work).
- **Invoice and bill designs**: A layout that matches your letterhead, your trade or a format your customers expect.
- **Extra fields**: More details on invoices, products or customers, printed where you need them.
- **Bill formats for your trade**: Special bills for your kind of business, with the columns and totals your trade uses.
- **New reports**: Reports and summaries built around the numbers you check every day or month.
- **Exports**: Send your data to Tally or another accounting app in the format it needs.
- **Changes to how it works**: Shortcuts, steps or screens adjusted to the way your counter works.

How it works:

1. **Tell us what you need**: Fill in the request form at https://invoiceo.in/customization.html#request. Sample bills or screenshots help a lot.
2. **Get a quote**: We reply with any questions and a price for the work. There is no charge for the quote.
3. **We build it**: Once you approve, we build and test it, and give you your updated version.

### Recent work: an energy bill for a solar power company

Made for Green & Green Agri Solutions, Udumalai: their monthly power-sale bill for wind and solar generation, built into Invoiceo. It shows (sample images use made-up names and numbers):

- Units generated, units allotted and the net units billed at the month’s rate
- The month’s deductions under “Less:” — transmission, wheeling, scheduling, meter reading and more — as fixed amounts or per unit, like the 10-paise self-generation tax
- Total expenses, round off and the net amount, with the amount in words
- Remembers last month’s wording, rate and deductions, so each new bill needs only the new numbers
- Bill numbers in the company’s own style, starting again each financial year (for example ABC/26-27/001)
- Saved like any invoice, so payments, balances and reports work as usual

### Recent work: sales and purchase on one bill, for a farm-products shop in Tamil Nadu

The shop sells to a customer and also buys from the same customer, on one bill. A private version of Invoiceo made for that shop, not part of the free app. It shows (sample images use made-up names and numbers):

- Sale and Purchase items on the same bill: the shop sells to the customer and also buys from the same customer
- Purchase items use the product’s buying price, and the rate can be changed on the bill
- Grand Total = Sales − Purchase, shown as “Pay customer” when the shop owes the customer
- Stock goes down on a sale and up on a purchase, and is corrected if a bill is edited or deleted
- Receipt for 58 mm and 80 mm thermal printers, with a SALES and a PURCHASE section
- No GST on the bill, and it works with the products already in the app

## Release notes

Every release, newest first (https://invoiceo.in/changelog.html).

### Version 1.0.8 (28 October 2026, 2026-10-28)

- **Easier sign-in.** Click the arrow in the Username box to pick your account from a list, and Invoiceo remembers who signed in last on that computer, so you only type the password.
- **Letter case no longer matters.** “ravi”, “Ravi” and “RAVI” open the same account. Your username can be any name you can remember, including your email address. Two older accounts that differ only by case (for example “Bob” and “bob”) still need the exact spelling, and a new account can no longer be made with a name that differs from an existing one only by case.
- Your data and accounts are unchanged: this release needs no database upgrade.

### Version 1.0.7 (23 October 2026, 2026-10-23)

- **Low-stock limit for each product.** Until now every product counted as “low” at 10 or less. Now you can set your own limit on a product, for example 50 for rice and 2 for an expensive item. The Low Stock list, its count, and the colour and label in the product list all follow it. Leave it blank and a product works exactly as before.
- The limit is in the New Product and Edit forms and in the products CSV (a new `low_stock_limit` column), and Duplicate keeps it.
- **New Product / New Service window.** In the Modern layout, adding a product now opens a clear window with General, Pricing and Inventory sections and a Track stock switch.
- Fixes: the “saved” message no longer covers the Save button on the next product, and the Unit box no longer overflows in Tamil.
- Your existing data and backups are safe: the app upgrades its database on first start, and older backups still restore.

### Version 1.0.6 (9 October 2026, 2026-10-09)

- **Tamil Settings screens read better.** PDF Settings, Invoice Settings, Company Info and Software Info now show the full Tamil words: the Reset to default button, template descriptions, and the notes under the invoice settings boxes are no longer cut off.
- Software Info shows the app description in Tamil, and the “Buy me a coffee” button reads clearly in Tamil.
- Shorter, clearer Tamil wording for a few settings labels.

### Version 1.0.5 (9 October 2026, 2026-10-09)

- **Tamil screens read better.** Long Tamil labels are no longer cut off with “…”: the sidebar, page titles, dashboard cards and charts, the invoice, customer and product lists, and the Reports menu now show the full words.
- On the New Invoice screen, when the buttons are too narrow for their names, Create goes full width with Save Draft under it.
- Shorter, clearer Tamil wording for a few page subtitles and card notes.

### Version 1.0.4 (9 October 2026, 2026-10-09)

- Anonymous usage counts are now on, so we can see how many shops use Invoiceo: a short message when the app is first opened, once a day while it is used, and once when the first invoice is made. They never include your business data. Turn them off any time in Settings → Software Info (see the [privacy policy](https://invoiceo.in/privacy.html)).

### Version 1.0.3 (9 October 2026, 2026-10-09)

- **Automatic backup.** Turn it on in Settings → Backup: every day or every week, while the app is open, a copy of your company’s data is saved by itself. Choose a folder inside Google Drive or OneDrive and the copies reach the cloud automatically.
- Keep the last 5, 10 or 30 automatic copies; older automatic copies are removed, and nothing else in the folder is touched.
- A clearer Backup page: saved backups show what they are (automatic, manual, before restore, JSON) with the right date and time.
- A warning on the dashboard if an automatic backup could not be saved, for example when the Drive folder is not available.

### Version 1.0.2 (8 October 2026, 2026-10-08)

The app is the same as version 1.0.1: there are no new features or fixes in this release. If you already have 1.0.1, you don’t need to update.

### Version 1.0.1 (8 October 2026, 2026-10-08)

Fixes and improvements from release testing.
- Stock can be a decimal number, so selling 0.5 kg takes exactly 0.5 from stock.
- Receipts now count as sales in Reports and on the dashboard.
- Tamil text prints correctly on payment receipts, customer statements and report PDFs.
- PDF Settings shows a real sample invoice with your company details as its preview.
- Every user can change their own password from the user menu.
- Importing a backup now checks the file first and never replaces your data with an empty or wrong file.
- Safer billing: a discount cannot make a line negative, quantity 0 is not accepted, and a converted quotation cannot be converted twice.
- The Windows installer also works on ARM laptops, and the Linux AppImage works on newer Ubuntu versions.

### Version 1.0.0 (8 October 2026, 2026-10-08)

The first release under the Invoiceo name.
- New name, logo and a clean light design.
- Tamil added as an app language, alongside English, Hindi, Nepali, French, Spanish, Chinese and Tibetan (partly translated).
- Two screen layouts to choose from in Settings: **Standard** and the new **Modern** layout, with a grouped sidebar, a top bar with a quick “new invoice, quotation or receipt” button, and a new dashboard.
- Thermal receipts with Tamil and other Indian-language text now print the same way they look in the preview.
- Receipts can print automatically after each invoice is created (Modern layout).
- In the Modern layout, an unfinished invoice can be saved as a draft and continued later from the Invoices list.
- Barcode scanning on the New Invoice screen is more reliable.
- In the Modern layout, Products and Services have their own pages, each with its own columns and filters, and the Customers page shows what each customer still owes.
- The app tells you when a newer version is out (it checks once a day while you are online; billing never needs the internet).
